summary: BUG-0064: render select pickers in the page (appearance: base-select) so Wayland compositors cannot dismiss Create VM dropdowns; supersedes the BUG-0050 overflow diagnosis.

guide.reason: Create VM troubleshooting explains the in-page dropdowns, which browsers get them, and the keyboard path elsewhere.

api.reason: Controller and local deploy page CSS only; no Controller/Core API or command behaviour changes.

state.reason: Presentation-only change; no durable pool or Controller state.

verification.method: Real-input and synthetic-click reproduction in Brave 152 on Hyprland 0.56.2 with OS-level captures, against a plain page and the real Create VM form; base-select verified in the real form and the built bundle; form_select_picker.py headless regression check fails on the old stylesheet and passes on the fix.
